answer: Admission runs through HullSeal, resolving a hull identification number against state registration and coast guard documentation records and refusing any hull already tied to a seat. The penalty trigger is a duplicate HIN or a registration cloned from a documented vessel, burning both bonds and docking it. Survey costs four fifty, registration one eighty, documentation one thirty three, so N fakes cost N times seven hundred sixty three dollars plus N survey days. No thread of paper shortens that, a cedar hull carries one stamped number, and no violet pennant hides a second owner.
